status: LANDED 2026-09-13 (builder cron af3e62239ce2, commit 803ed8d) - option 1 (widen the predicate) + option 2 spirit (the wrapper now delegates to tools/agy_evidence_check.sh; the detector's verdicts are exercised by the gate rather than printed). Gate tests/test_agy_wrapper_evidence.py 6/6 (L1 calibration: the 204459 log flips UNVERIFIED->VERIFIED, old predicate shown RED on it; L2 no-evidence negatives incl. the 09:09 'no output produced' shape, still UNVERIFIED; L3 conjunction load-bearing; L4 literal-header fast path; L5 self-test; plus patch-applies-cleanly). measured.observed: agy_implement: UNVERIFIED - reply carries no DIFF SUMMARY block (no gate evidence) - FAIL / exit 3
reply_actually_contains: '### 2. Raw gate tail post-edit' -> '3 passed, 5 xfailed in 0.63s'
'### 5. git diff --stat & git status' + 'git status --short tests/ tools/'
measured.orchestrator_outcome: every leg re-run independently; gate green (3 passed, 5 xfailed, rc 0) and non-vacuity proven (--runxfail -> 5 failed with the original AttributeError). The work was complete; only the wrapper's verdict was wrong.

why_it_matters: A false UNVERIFIED/exit-3 is the failure mode that trains an orchestrator to ignore the wrapper. The wrapper exists to catch the opposite shape (exit 0 with no evidence, the 09:09 incident), so its positive class must stay trustworthy.
options_cheapest_first: 1. Widen the predicate: accept any of {literal 'DIFF SUMMARY', a section whose body carries the brief's own gate command AND its literal output tail, a 'gate tail'/'gate output' heading}. Show RED against a reply log with no gate evidence at all (e.g. the 'no output produced' shape) and GREEN against output/agy/agy_impl_20260913_204459.log.
2. Make the wrapper PRINT the detector's matched/expected token on failure, so the reason is visible in the log instead of asserted.
3. Do nothing but stop treating rc as a claim of failure: document in the wrapper header that rc=3 means 'the reply did not carry a recognisable evidence block' and is not a judgement on the work.
gate_clause: A wrapper self-test whose fixture replies are (a) the real 2026-09-13 reply log -> must be classified VERIFIED, and (b) a reply with no gate command or output -> must be classified UNVERIFIED. Today (a) is classified UNVERIFIED, so the leg is RED-first by construction.
not_proven: That any other delegation's exit code was mis-read in the same way; the wrapper's other guards (no output produced, empty log) were not probed.
